description: Main source file for Bluetooth Cycling Speed and Cadence (CSC) application using Zephyr RTOS, implementing BLE services, characteristics, and simulation logic.

methods.name: csc_meas_ccc_cfg_changed
methods.description: Callback for CSC measurement CCC configuration changes, toggles simulation.

methods.name: ctrl_point_ccc_cfg_changed
methods.description: Callback for control point CCC configuration changes, toggles indication.

methods.name: write_ctrl_point
methods.description: Handles write requests to the CSC control point, updates wheel revolutions or sensor location.

methods.name: ctrl_point_ind
methods.description: Sends indication for control point responses.

methods.name: measurement_nfy
methods.description: Notifies CSC measurement including wheel and crank data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point initializing Bluetooth, starting advertising, and running main loop with simulation.
